## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that addresses it.

## Change type

- [ ] Documentation or translation only
- [ ] Generic example or fixture
- [ ] Runtime evidence
- [ ] Canonical Skill or contract change

## Evidence

List the commands, observations, fixtures, or review used. Label missing evidence explicitly.

## Safety and scope

- [ ] No secret, credential, private path, private URL, personal data, log, or conversation dump is included.
- [ ] Capability and permission remain distinct.
- [ ] Unknown change ownership still requires STOP.
- [ ] Translated README facts remain aligned.
- [ ] Version impact is stated and justified.
- [ ] No orchestration, service, database, scheduler, registry, or automatic write-back was added.
